摘要

Abstract

BACKGROUND Specialized single-use, single-modality models often have limited or no generalization to new diseases, modalities, and clinical tasks. Foundation models are built for multipurpose use, enabling them to perform tasks even when not specifically pretrained for them, and to adapt to diferent clinical applications.

背景 专门针对单一用途、单一模态的模型往往对新疾病、新模态以及临床任务的泛化能力有限甚至缺失。基础模型则旨在实现多用途，使其在未针对特定任务进行预训练的情况下也能完成相应工作，并适应不同的临床应用场景。

背景 专门针对单一用途、单一模态的模型往往对新疾病、新模态以及临床任务的泛化能力有限甚至缺失。基础模型则旨在实现多用途，使其在未针对特定任务进行预训练的情况下也能完成相应工作，并适应不同的临床应用场景。

METHODS We present VisionFM, an artificial intelligence foundation model for ophthalmology pretrained on 3.4 million images from over 500,000 individuals, covering diverse ophthalmic diseases, imaging modalities and devices, and clinical scenarios. Pretrained based on eight modalities, VisionFM was tested for multiple applications, including disease screening and detection, prognosis and prediction, and segmentation of lesions and anatomical structures, on an ophthalmic database comprising 53 public and 12 private datasets. We compared the model against ophthalmologists with varying experience in ophthalmic and systemic disease diagnoses.

方法 我们提出了VisionFM，这是一种面向眼科学的人工智能基础模型，基于来自超过50万名受试者的340万张图像进行预训练，涵盖了多种眼科疾病、成像模态与设备以及临床场景。VisionFM以八种成像模态为依托进行预训练，并在包含53个公开数据集和12个私有数据集的眼科数据库上开展了多项应用验证，涉及疾病筛查与检测、预后与预测，以及病灶与解剖结构的分割等任务。我们还将该模型与具有不同经验的眼科及全身性疾病诊断医师进行了对比。

方法 我们提出了VisionFM，这是一种面向眼科学的人工智能基础模型，基于来自超过50万名受试者的340万张图像进行预训练，涵盖了多种眼科疾病、成像模态与设备以及临床场景。VisionFM以八种成像模态为依托进行预训练，并在包含53个公开数据集和12个私有数据集的眼科数据库上开展了多项应用验证，涉及疾病筛查与检测、预后与预测，以及病灶与解剖结构的分割等任务。我们还将该模型与具有不同经验的眼科及全身性疾病诊断医师进行了对比。

RESULTS VisionFM outperformed baseline deep learning approaches in diagnosing ocular diseases, achieving an average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.950 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.941 to 0.959) across eight disease categories and five imaging modalities in internal validation. In external validation, VisionFM achieved an AUROC of 0.945 (95% CI, 0.934 to 0.956) in fundus-based diabetic retinopathy recognition, and an AUROC of 0.974 (95% CI, 0.966 to 0.983) in optical coherence tomography–based age-related macular degeneration recognition. In a comparative study of diagnostic accuracy of 12 ocular diseases from fundus photographs, VisionFM shows diagnostic accuracy close to that of intermediate-level ophthalmologists. CONCLUSIONS VisionFM provides an eficient platform for diagnosis or prediction of multiple diseases using multiple imaging modalities and is scalable to incorporate additional data, modalities, and applications via its open-sourced model weights and codebase. 结论 VisionFM 为基于多种医学影像模态的多病种诊断与预测提供了一个高效平台，并可通过其开源的模型权重与代码库扩展至纳入更多数据、模态及应用场景。（资助单位：香港特别行政区研究资助局及其他机构。）

结论 VisionFM 为基于多种医学影像模态的多病种诊断与预测提供了一个高效平台，并可通过其开源的模型权重与代码库扩展至纳入更多数据、模态及应用场景。（资助单位：香港特别行政区研究资助局及其他机构。）

引言

Introduction

V ist ion impairment and major ophthalmic diseases hat cause it (e.g., cataract, age-related macular degeneration, glaucoma) are prevalent globally. By 2050, an estimated 474 million individuals may experience moderate to severe vision impairment.1 There is an acute shortage of high-quality ophthalmologists, especially in low-income countries.2 Despite eforts to develop ophthalmic AI for automated diagnoses,3-16 current models have limitations. They require extensive annotated data, which is costly and ineficient. Most models focus on single or limited diseases, use single imaging modalities (e.g., fundus photographs), and are task-specific (e.g., screening for diabetic retinopathy17), limiting their broader clinical application (Fig. 1A).

视力障碍及其所致的主要眼科疾病（如白内障、年龄相关性黄斑变性、青光眼）在全球范围内普遍存在。预计到2050年，将有约4.74亿人遭受中度至重度视力损害。1 然而，高质量的眼科医师严重短缺，尤其是在低收入国家。2 尽管人们致力于开发用于自动诊断的眼科人工智能系统，3–16 但现有模型仍存在诸多局限：其训练需要大量标注数据，成本高昂且效率低下；多数模型仅针对单一或少数几种疾病，所用成像模态单一（如眼底照相），且任务专一（如糖尿病视网膜病变的筛查17），这在很大程度上限制了其更广泛的临床应用（图1A）。

视力障碍及其所致的主要眼科疾病（如白内障、年龄相关性黄斑变性、青光眼）在全球范围内普遍存在。预计到2050年，将有约4.74亿人遭受中度至重度视力损害。1 然而，高质量的眼科医师严重短缺，尤其是在低收入国家。2 尽管人们致力于开发用于自动诊断的眼科人工智能系统，3–16 但现有模型仍存在诸多局限：其训练需要大量标注数据，成本高昂且效率低下；多数模型仅针对单一或少数几种疾病，所用成像模态单一（如眼底照相），且任务专一（如糖尿病视网膜病变的筛查17），这在很大程度上限制了其更广泛的临床应用（图1A）。

AI foundation models available to the public,18-20 like the generative pretrained transformer (GPT-4)21 model and the segment anything model (SAM),22 are trained on broad data and can adapt to solve a wide range of tasks, presenting new opportunities to address global ophthalmic challenges. Within the ophthalmic field, the first foundation model, RETFound,23 demonstrates such generalist intelligence by detecting diseases from retinal images. However, it processes only fundus photography and optical coherence tomography (OCT), with limited clinical tasks.

面向公众开放的AI基础模型，如生成式预训练变换器（GPT‑4）模型和“一切分割”模型（SAM），18–20 均基于海量数据进行训练，并可灵活适配以解决多种任务，为应对全球眼科领域的挑战提供了新的机遇。在眼科领域，首个基础模型——RETFound——23 通过从视网膜图像中识别疾病展现了此类通用智能；然而，该模型仅处理眼底照相与光学相干断层扫描（OCT）数据，且所能支持的临床任务较为有限。

面向公众开放的AI基础模型，如生成式预训练变换器（GPT‑4）模型和“一切分割”模型（SAM），18–20 均基于海量数据进行训练，并可灵活适配以解决多种任务，为应对全球眼科领域的挑战提供了新的机遇。在眼科领域，首个基础模型——RETFound——23 通过从视网膜图像中识别疾病展现了此类通用智能；然而，该模型仅处理眼底照相与光学相干断层扫描（OCT）数据，且所能支持的临床任务较为有限。

We developed VisionFM (Fig. 1B), an ophthalmic foundation model pretrained with 3.4 million diverse ophthalmic images. It covers various ophthalmic diseases, imaging modalities, devices, and demographic data, enabling applications such as disease screening, diagnosis, phenotype subclassification, disease progression prediction, and systemic biomarker detection. VisionFM demonstrates fewshot diagnostic capabilities generalizing to unseen data. Additionally, we show that high-quality synthetic ophthalmic data that passed Turing tests24 could enhance the pretraining of foundation models like VisionFM.

我们提出了VisionFM（图1B），这是一种基于340万张多样化眼科图像进行预训练的眼科基础模型。该模型涵盖了多种眼科疾病、成像模态、设备类型以及人口学特征，可支持疾病筛查、诊断、表型亚型划分、疾病进展预测以及全身性生物标志物检测等应用场景。VisionFM展现出对未见数据具有泛化的零样本诊断能力。此外，我们还表明，通过图灵测试24的高质量合成眼科数据能够有效提升类似VisionFM这类基础模型的预训练效果。

方法

Methods

研究设计与监督

STUDY DESIGN AND OVERSIGHT

We used public and private datasets to develop and validate VisionFM. The study was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki and was approved by the institutional review board of Beijing Tongren Hospital of Capital Medical University, the First Afiliated Hospital of Xi’an Jiaotong University, and Handan Eye Hospital Ethics Committee (TREC2023-KY126 and 2023005). Informed consent from patients was exempted by the institutional review board, as only de-identified retrospective data were used.

我们利用公开与私有数据集对VisionFM进行了开发与验证。本研究遵循《赫尔辛基宣言》，并已获得首都医科大学附属北京同仁医院、西安交通大学第一附属医院以及邯郸市眼科医院伦理委员会的批准（TREC2023-KY126和2023005）。鉴于仅使用了经脱敏处理的回顾性数据，患者知情同意程序已获伦理委员会豁免。

我们利用公开与私有数据集对VisionFM进行了开发与验证。本研究遵循《赫尔辛基宣言》，并已获得首都医科大学附属北京同仁医院、西安交通大学第一附属医院以及邯郸市眼科医院伦理委员会的批准（TREC2023-KY126和2023005）。鉴于仅使用了经脱敏处理的回顾性数据，患者知情同意程序已获伦理委员会豁免。

VISIONFM 预训练数据

VISIONFM PRETRAINING DATA

Figure 1C and Figure 1D summarize the pretraining data (3.4 million images, over 560,400 participants. For more details, please refer to Supplementary Table S1). Only private data were used for pretraining on ultrasound biomicroscopy, slit-lamp, fundus fluorescein angiography, and B-scan ultrasonography due to the low availability of public data. Both public and private data were used for remaining modalities. For public magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) datasets used in pretraining, we manually removed MRI slices devoid of ocular anatomy due to low relevance to this work.

VISIONFM 的实现与评估

VISIONFM IMPLEMENTATION AND EVALUATION

VisionFM uses separate encoders for eight specific ophthalmic imaging modalities. All encoders are based on Vision Transformer,25 a neural network architecture that processes an image by dividing it into patches and analyzing them using a self-attention mechanism. We leveraged the iBOT26 self-supervised learning scheme, which is based on masked image modeling and self-distillation, to pretrain each encoder. VisionFM was then examined in a diverse range of scenarios and applications as shown in the Results section and Supplementary Appendix (see Section 2) using various task-specific decoders. For ophthalmic disease diagnosis, both internal and external validation were conducted, whereas for the remaining four task categories (i.e., glaucoma forecasting; systemic biomarker and disease prediction; landmark detection; and lesion, vessel, and layer segmentation), only internal validation was conducted due to limited validation data availability. Results

眼科疾病识别、分级及其与临床医生的比较

OPHTHALMIC DISEASE RECOGNITION, GRADING, AND COMPARISON WITH CLINICIANS

To evaluate VisionFM’s performance, we compared VisionFM and prior state-of-the-art models, including RETFound and EficientNet-B7,27 in recognizing eight ophthalmic diseases on a large-scale benchmark comprising 23 public and 5 private datasets, covering 5 imaging modalities (Table 1; see Supplementary Table S2 for benchmark details). Two distinct implementations were developed for VisionFM: modality-agnostic (MA) disease recognition and modality- and disease-specific (MDS) implementation. The MA approach involved a single multiclass classifier that can classify an input image, regardless of the imaging modality, into one of the eight predefined ophthalmic diseases or as healthy. The MDS implementation employs a binary classifier for each disease within a specific modality to identify the presence of that disease in an image. While the MDS approach is commonly used in ophthalmic AI models,3,4,23 the MA approach is unique to VisionFM. The predictive probabilities from the classifiers were used to calculate area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), sensitivity, and specificity. Ninety-five percent exact Clopper–Pearson confidence intervals were calculated for each metric. As summarized in Table 1, the performance of a model varies across diseases and modalities. For example, hypertensive retinopathy was more challenging to accurately diagnose using all models than diseases like retinal vein occlusion and myopia using fundus photographs. Nonetheless, the MA approach of VisionFM can surpass or be comparable to prior classifier-heavy models. While the multimodal learning scheme underlying the MA implementation can enhance the diagnoses of certain diseases such as hypertensive retinopathy, we observe that such enhancement derived from multimodal learning is not universally applicable to all disease categories. The MDS implementation of VisionFM can generally lead to higher and specialist diagnostic accuracy across diseases, achieving an overall

为评估VisionFM的性能，我们在一个大规模基准上将其与包括RETFound和EfficientNet‑B7在内的现有最先进模型进行了对比，该基准由23个公开数据集和5个私有数据集组成，涵盖了5种成像模态（表1；有关基准的详细信息见补充表S2）。针对VisionFM，我们设计了两种不同的实现方案：一种是模态无关的疾病识别（MA），另一种是模态与疾病特异性的实现（MDS）。MA方案采用单一的多分类器，能够对任意成像模态的输入图像进行分类，将其归入八类预定义的眼科疾病之一，或判定为健康；而MDS方案则针对每种特定模态下的每种疾病分别构建二分类器，用于判断图像中是否存在该疾病。尽管MDS方案在眼科人工智能模型中较为常见，但MA方案却是VisionFM所独有的。我们基于各分类器的预测概率计算了受试者工作特征曲线下的面积（AUROC）、灵敏度和特异性，并为各项指标分别构建了95%置信水平的精确Clopper–Pearson置信区间。如表1所示，不同模型在各类疾病及不同模态上的表现存在差异。例如，与使用眼底照片诊断视网膜静脉阻塞和近视等疾病相比，利用所有模型准确诊断高血压性视网膜病变的难度更大。然而，VisionFM的MA方案在多数情况下能够超越或与以往以分类器为核心的模型相媲美。虽然MA实现所依托的多模态学习机制有助于提升某些疾病的诊断能力，例如高血压性视网膜病变，但我们发现，这种由多模态学习带来的增益并不适用于所有疾病类别。相比之下，VisionFM的MDS实现通常能够在各类疾病上获得更高且更具专业性的诊断精度，从而实现整体

To better understand VisionFM’s diagnostic capability, we compared it with that of ophthalmologists with varying levels of clinical experience. We designed a task to diagnose 12 ocular diseases (mild, moderate, or severe nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy; proliferative diabetic retinopathy; glaucoma; cataract; hypertensive retinopathy; myopia; retinal vein occlusion; retinal detachment; early age-related macular degeneration; and intermediate age-related macular degeneration) where junior- and intermediate-level ophthalmologists were asked to select the most likely, second most likely, and third most likely diseases for each fundus photograph. We recruited 38 ophthalmologists from four eye centers in China: 27 at the junior level (1 to 3 years of clinical experience) and 11 at the intermediate level (4 to 8 years of clinical experience). A total of 180 fundus pho tographs were evaluated for the diagnosis task, each annotated with consensus by four senior ophthalmologists (more than 9 years of clinical experience), with each image having a single label for the most prominent disease. This is based on the hypothesis that the ophthalmologists have the ability to diagnose the most obvious disease within their top three choices. The fundus photographs were evenly divided into three sets, and the ophthalmologists could select the same disease as their top three choices. To account for variations in clinical practice, a tutorial video explaining the diagnostic criteria for the 12 diseases was prepared by a senior ophthalmologist. Group 1 (20 ophthalmologists) diagnosed before and after watching the video, while the remaining 18 made their diagnoses after viewing it. Ophthalmologists were blinded to each others’ diagnoses. Top-K accuracy, where the true label is within the first k choices, was calculated. Additionally, we fine-tuned VisionFM using 24 fundus photographs, with two exemplar images for each disease as shown in the tutorial video. Table 2 shows that the diagnostic ability of the fine-tuned VisionFM is comparable to or better than that of intermediate-level ophthalmologists who watched the tutorial video, and its performance is more consistent, as indicated by a smaller standard deviation. Supplementary Table S6 and Table S7 show the sensitivity and specificity of VisionFM and ophthalmologists

为更深入地评估VisionFM的诊断能力，我们将其与不同临床经验层次的眼科医师进行了对比。我们设计了一项针对12种眼病的诊断任务：轻度、中度或重度非增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变、增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变、青光眼、白内障、高血压性视网膜病变、近视、视网膜静脉阻塞、视网膜脱离、早期年龄相关性黄斑变性以及中期年龄相关性黄斑变性。在该任务中，初级和中级职称的眼科医师需分别为每张眼底照片选出最可能、次可能和第三可能的疾病。我们从中国四家眼科中心招募了38名眼科医师，其中初级组27人（临床工作经验1至3年），中级组11人（临床工作经验4至8年）。用于诊断评估的共有180张眼底照片，每张均由四位资深眼科医师（临床工作经验9年以上）达成共识标注，且每幅图像仅标注一种最显著疾病的单一标签。这一设定基于如下假设：眼科医师在其前三项候选诊断中应能识别出最为明显的疾病。眼底照片被等分为三组，且眼科医师可在各组中重复选择同一疾病作为其前三项候选之一。为考虑临床实践中的差异，一位资深眼科医师制作并提供了包含上述12种疾病诊断标准的指导视频。第一组20名眼科医师在观看视频前后分别进行诊断，其余18名则在观看视频后再作答。所有眼科医师均不知晓彼此的诊断结果。我们计算了Top-K准确率，即真实标签位于前k个候选中的概率。此外，我们还利用24张眼底照片对VisionFM进行了微调，所用样本包括指导视频中展示的每种疾病各两张典型图像。表2显示，经微调后的VisionFM的诊断能力与观看了指导视频的中级职称眼科医师相当甚至更为优异，且其性能更为稳定，表现为标准差更小。补充表S6和S7分别展示了VisionFM与眼科医师的灵敏度和特异度。

为更深入地评估VisionFM的诊断能力，我们将其与不同临床经验层次的眼科医师进行了对比。我们设计了一项针对12种眼病的诊断任务：轻度、中度或重度非增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变、增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变、青光眼、白内障、高血压性视网膜病变、近视、视网膜静脉阻塞、视网膜脱离、早期年龄相关性黄斑变性以及中期年龄相关性黄斑变性。在该任务中，初级和中级职称的眼科医师需分别为每张眼底照片选出最可能、次可能和第三可能的疾病。我们从中国四家眼科中心招募了38名眼科医师，其中初级组27人（临床工作经验1至3年），中级组11人（临床工作经验4至8年）。用于诊断评估的共有180张眼底照片，每张均由四位资深眼科医师（临床工作经验9年以上）达成共识标注，且每幅图像仅标注一种最显著疾病的单一标签。这一设定基于如下假设：眼科医师在其前三项候选诊断中应能识别出最为明显的疾病。眼底照片被等分为三组，且眼科医师可在各组中重复选择同一疾病作为其前三项候选之一。为考虑临床实践中的差异，一位资深眼科医师制作并提供了包含上述12种疾病诊断标准的指导视频。第一组20名眼科医师在观看视频前后分别进行诊断，其余18名则在观看视频后再作答。所有眼科医师均不知晓彼此的诊断结果。我们计算了Top-K准确率，即真实标签位于前k个候选中的概率。此外，我们还利用24张眼底照片对VisionFM进行了微调，所用样本包括指导视频中展示的每种疾病各两张典型图像。表2显示，经微调后的VisionFM的诊断能力与观看了指导视频的中级职称眼科医师相当甚至更为优异，且其性能更为稳定，表现为标准差更小。补充表S6和S7分别展示了VisionFM与眼科医师的灵敏度和特异度。

AUROC denotes area under the receiver operating characteristic curve; CI, exact Clopper–Pearson confidence interval; MA, modality-agnostic; MDS, modality- and diseasespecific; and OCT, optical coherence tomography. † The best results of each task.

\* 在模态无关（MA）实现中，仅训练了一个能够从所有成像模态中识别所有疾病的分类器；而在模态与疾病特异性（MDS）实现中，针对每种模态和每种疾病分别训练了一个分类器（即对于VisionFM和EfficientNet，16个分类器对应16项任务；而对于RETFound，由于其仅适用于基于眼底和OCT的任务，因此11个分类器对应11项任务）。AUROC表示受试者工作特征曲线下的面积；CI为精确的Clopper–Pearson置信区间；MA指模态无关；MDS指模态与疾病特异性；OCT为光学相干断层扫描。† 各项任务的最佳结果。

\* 在模态无关（MA）实现中，仅训练了一个能够从所有成像模态中识别所有疾病的分类器；而在模态与疾病特异性（MDS）实现中，针对每种模态和每种疾病分别训练了一个分类器（即对于VisionFM和EfficientNet，16个分类器对应16项任务；而对于RETFound，由于其仅适用于基于眼底和OCT的任务，因此11个分类器对应11项任务）。AUROC表示受试者工作特征曲线下的面积；CI为精确的Clopper–Pearson置信区间；MA指模态无关；MDS指模态与疾病特异性；OCT为光学相干断层扫描。† 各项任务的最佳结果。

用于眼部疾病诊断的外部验证与模型泛化

EXTERNAL VALIDATION FOR OCULAR DISEASEDIAGNOSIS AND GENERALIZATION

To examine the generalizability of VisionFM in disease diagnosis, external validation was conducted using three public datasets that were not included in the benchmark database: the Paraguayan dataset with 1437 fundus photographs for diabetic retinopathy28; the Indian Drishti-GS1 dataset with 101 fundus photographs for glaucoma29; and the Russian Optical Coherence Tomography Dataset for Image-Based Deep Learning Methods, with 1169 OCT images for age-related macular degeneration.30 The MDS classifiers of VisionFM and RETFound in Table 1 were used to perform recognition directly without any fine-tuning. As shown in Figure 2A–C, VisionFM outperformed RETFound on all three datasets: AUROC, 0.945 (95% CI, 0.934 to 0.956) versus 0.759 (95% CI, 0.734 to 0.785) in recognizing diabetic retinopathy; AUROC, 0.857 (95% CI, 0.760 to 0.935) versus 0.778 (95% CI, 0.660 to 0.877) in recognizing glaucoma; and AUROC, 0.974 (95% CI, 0.966 to 0.983) versus 0.844 (95% CI, 0.811 to 0.872) in recognizing age-related macular degeneration.

为考察VisionFM在疾病诊断中的泛化能力，我们采用三个未纳入基准数据库的公开数据集进行了外部验证：用于糖尿病视网膜病变检测的巴拉圭数据集，包含1437张眼底图像28；用于青光眼检测的印度Drishti‑GS1数据集，包含101张眼底图像29；以及用于基于图像的深度学习方法的俄罗斯光学相干断层扫描数据集，包含1169幅用于年龄相关性黄斑变性的OCT图像30。表1中VisionFM与RETFound的多标签分类器均直接用于识别任务，未进行任何微调。如图2A–C所示，在上述三个数据集上，VisionFM均优于RETFound：在糖尿病视网膜病变的识别中，AUROC分别为0.945（95%置信区间，0.934至0.956）和0.759（95%置信区间，0.734至0.785）；在青光眼的识别中，AUROC分别为0.857（95%置信区间，0.760至0.935）和0.778（95%置信区间，0.660至0.877）；在年龄相关性黄斑变性的识别中，AUROC分别为0.974（95%置信区间，0.966至0.983）和0.844（95%置信区间，0.811至0.872）。

为考察VisionFM在疾病诊断中的泛化能力，我们采用三个未纳入基准数据库的公开数据集进行了外部验证：用于糖尿病视网膜病变检测的巴拉圭数据集，包含1437张眼底图像28；用于青光眼检测的印度Drishti‑GS1数据集，包含101张眼底图像29；以及用于基于图像的深度学习方法的俄罗斯光学相干断层扫描数据集，包含1169幅用于年龄相关性黄斑变性的OCT图像30。表1中VisionFM与RETFound的多标签分类器均直接用于识别任务，未进行任何微调。如图2A–C所示，在上述三个数据集上，VisionFM均优于RETFound：在糖尿病视网膜病变的识别中，AUROC分别为0.945（95%置信区间，0.934至0.956）和0.759（95%置信区间，0.734至0.785）；在青光眼的识别中，AUROC分别为0.857（95%置信区间，0.760至0.935）和0.778（95%置信区间，0.660至0.877）；在年龄相关性黄斑变性的识别中，AUROC分别为0.974（95%置信区间，0.966至0.983）和0.844（95%置信区间，0.811至0.872）。

Figure 2D–F summarizes the results of generalization to new modality, disease, and imaging devices. Notably, although VisionFM was never pretrained on optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) data, it achieved an average AUROC of 0.935 (95% CI, 0.902 to 0.964) for grading diabetic retinopathy with OCTA images on the public Diabetic Retinopathy Analysis Challenge dataset (120 images),31 surpassing the prior state-of-the-art model, EficientNet (average AUROC, 0.921; 95% CI, 0.885 to 0.953) (Supplementary Fig. S1). Additionally, VisionFM demonstrated generalizability to new imaging devices as shown in grading diabetic retinopathy on the public Deep Diabetic Retinopathy Image Dataset (100 images)32, which includes fundus photographs captured by ultra-widefield imaging devices. to 0.815) (Supplementary Fig. S2). VisionFM can achieve an AUROC of 0.993 (95% CI, 0.970 to 1.00) with one annotated sample (one-shot) for recognizing ocular albinism, outperforming RETFound (AUROC, 0.911; 95% CI, 0.812 to 0.981). With five samples (five-shot), the AUROC increases to 0.998 (95% CI, 0.986 to 1.00) compared with RETFound’s 0.965 (95% CI, 0.905 to 1.00), and with ten samples (ten-shot), VisionFM correctly identifies all 41 test images, surpassing RETFound again (AUROC, 0.976; 95% CI, 0.924 to 1.00) (Supplementary Fig. S3). However, as ocular albinism has a distinct phenotype, further research is needed to assess VisionFM’s few-shot capabilities for more complex ocular diseases. As shown in Supplementary Table S6 and Table S7, its few-shot diagnostic performance for multiple diseases can be further improved. For example, in grading diabetic retinopathy, junior- and intermediate-level ophthalmologists demonstrate higher sensitivity and specificity than VisionFM. More details about generalization studies are available in the Supplementary Appendix (see Section 2.2).

至0.815）（补充图S2）。VisionFM仅需一个标注样本（单样本学习）即可实现0.993的AUROC（95%置信区间为0.970至1.00），在识别眼白化病方面优于RETFound（AUROC为0.911，95%置信区间为0.812至0.981）。当使用五个样本（五样本学习）时，其AUROC进一步提升至0.998（95%置信区间为0.986至1.00），而RETFound仅为0.965（95%置信区间为0.905至1.00）；在十个样本（十样本学习）的情况下，VisionFM能够正确识别全部41张测试图像，再次超越RETFound（AUROC为0.976，95%置信区间为0.924至1.00）（补充图S3）。然而，由于眼白化病具有较为独特的表型特征，仍需开展进一步研究，以评估VisionFM在更为复杂的眼科疾病上的少样本学习能力。如补充表S6和表S7所示，其针对多种疾病的少样本诊断性能仍有提升空间。例如，在糖尿病视网膜病变分级任务中，初级与中级眼科医师的灵敏度和特异性均高于VisionFM。有关泛化性能研究的更多细节详见补充附录（参见第2.2节）。

青光眼进展预测

GLAUCOMA PROGRESSION FORECASTING

To evaluate VisionFM’s potential in predicting glaucoma progression, a dificult task due to its asymptomatic and chronic nature, we analyzed its performance using a private dataset containing 411 participants, with an average follow-up window of 2.82 years. Specifically, VisionFM can predict whether a participant will have developed glaucoma by their next clinic visit, based on the fundus photograph taken at the current visit and the time interval between visits. VisionFM achieved an F1 score of 72.3% (95% CI, 55.0 to 86.3) in predicting glaucoma progression, outperforming RETFound (F1 score, 60.1%; 95% CI, 45.0 to 74.3). VisionFM also led in other measured metrics, including accuracy, where metrics were calculated by thresholding predictive probabilities at 0.5 (Supplementary Appendix, see Section 2.3 and Supplementary Table S8).

为评估VisionFM在青光眼进展预测方面的潜力——这一任务因其无症状性和慢性病程而颇具挑战——我们基于一个包含411名受试者的自有数据集对其性能进行了分析，该数据集的平均随访时长为2.82年。具体而言，VisionFM可根据当前就诊时采集的眼底图像及两次就诊之间的间隔时间，预测受试者在下一次门诊时是否已发展为青光眼。在青光眼进展预测任务上，VisionFM的F1分数达到72.3%（95%置信区间，55.0至86.3），优于RETFound（F1分数为60.1%，95%置信区间，45.0至74.3）。在其他评价指标方面，VisionFM同样表现更优，包括以0.5作为预测概率阈值计算得到的准确率等指标（详见补充附录第2.3节及补充表S8）。

基于眼科影像的系统性生物标志物与疾病预测

SYSTEMIC BIOMARKERS AND DISEASE PREDICTION FROM OPHTHALMIC IMAGES

Prior research has indicated that signs of systemic diseases can manifest in ocular images.23,33,34 We assessed whether VisionFM could predict systemic biomarkers and diseases solely from ophthalmic images. Using a private dataset containing 8217 participants, we examined VisionFM’s ability to predict 38 systemic biomarkers related to complete blood count, liver function, renal function, and serum glucose and lipids from fundus and external eye photographs. VisionFM achieved an average normalized root mean square error (NRMSE) of 1.001 (95% CI, 0.991 to 1.011), compared with 1.027 (95% CI, 1.011 to 1.043) of ResNet,35 a widely used baseline model (Fig. 2G, Supplementary Table S9). Notably, VisionFM achieved an average NRMSE of 0.985 (95% CI, 0.954 to 1.015) for four renal function biomarkers, suggesting a potential association between renal and ocular health. Figure 2H and Figure 2I show VisionFM’s predicted versus actual uric acid values in the test set, with the clinical diagnosis of gout based on a cutof value (360 µmol/l).36

先前的研究表明，全身性疾病的征象可在眼部影像中显现。23,33,34 我们评估了VisionFM是否仅凭眼科影像即可预测全身性生物标志物及疾病。基于包含8217名受试者的自有数据集，我们考察了VisionFM从眼底照片和眼前部照片中预测与血常规、肝功能、肾功能以及血清葡萄糖和血脂相关的38种全身性生物标志物的能力。结果显示，VisionFM的平均归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）为1.001（95%置信区间，0.991至1.011），而广泛使用的基准模型ResNet的相应指标为1.027（95%置信区间，1.011至1.043）（图2G，补充表S9）。值得注意的是，对于四项肾功能相关生物标志物，VisionFM的平均NRMSE达到0.985（95%置信区间，0.954至1.015），这提示肾功能与眼部健康之间可能存在潜在关联。图2H和图2I展示了VisionFM在测试集中对尿酸水平的预测值与实际值的对比，其中痛风的临床诊断依据为一个阈值（360 µmol/L）。36

An intracranial tumor can afect an individual’s visual function. Detecting subtle alterations in ocular image induced by the tumor requires comprehensive examinations, particularly when the underlying cause remains unclear. To date, no research has investigated the direct prediction of an intracranial tumor from ophthalmic images. We explored whether VisionFM could address this gap to predict an intracranial tumor using fundus photographs. In a hospital dataset where 35 out of 58 participants were diagnosed with intracranial tumors, with only 9 exhibiting papilledema, VisionFM achieved an AUROC of 0.986 (95% CI, 0.960 to 1.00) and an area under the precision-recall curve of 0.990 (95% CI, 0.970 to 1.00) for detecting intracranial tumors. In contrast, intermediate- and seniorlevel clinicians found it challenging to identify intracranial tumors from fundus photographs (Supplementary Fig. S4 and Fig. S5, Supplementary Table S10). These results suggest that VisionFM can potentially identify patterns and systemic associations not readily apparent to humans. However, although cross-validation was conducted due to the limited data availability, future studies with larger sample sizes are necessary to confirm this preliminary finding. More details are shown in Supplementary Figure S6 and the Supplementary Appendix (see Section 2.4).

颅内肿瘤可影响个体的视觉功能。检测由肿瘤诱发的眼部影像中的细微变化需要进行全面的临床检查，尤其是在病因尚不明确的情况下更为必要。迄今为止，尚无研究直接基于眼科影像对颅内肿瘤进行预测。我们探讨了VisionFM是否能够弥补这一空白，利用眼底彩色照相对颅内肿瘤进行预测。在一项医院数据集中，58名受试者中有35人被诊断为颅内肿瘤，其中仅9例存在视盘水肿；结果显示，VisionFM在颅内肿瘤检测任务上取得了0.986的AUROC（95%置信区间为0.960至1.00），以及0.990的精确率–召回率曲线下面积（95%置信区间为0.970至1.00）。相比之下，中级和高级别临床医师难以仅凭眼底照片识别颅内肿瘤（见补充图S4和S5、补充表S10）。这些结果表明，VisionFM有望捕捉人类难以察觉的模式与系统性关联。然而，鉴于数据量有限，虽已采用交叉验证，但仍需开展更大样本规模的后续研究以确证这一初步发现。更多细节详见补充图S6及补充附录（参见第2.4节）。

眼部病灶、血管、层次分割及特征点检测

OCULAR LESION, VESSEL, LAYER SEGMENTATION, AND LANDMARK DETECTION

Segmentation and related capabilities are critical measures of foundation model performance in medical imaging. Figure 3A summarizes VisionFM’s performance in various segmentation tasks across a comprehensive benchmark comprising 22 public and 1 private dataset (Supplementary Table S11, Table S12, and Table S13). In segmenting fundus photographs, VisionFM achieved Dice similarity coefficients (which measure the extent of overlap between the true and predicted masks) of 81.75% for blood vessels and 42.07% for lesions. Notably, VisionFM outperformed both baseline models in OCT-based segmentation — RETFound and U-Net,37 a widely utilized baseline model for segmentation (Dice scores: VisionFM, 96.18% for OCT layer and 64.65% for lesion; U-Net, 89.70% for OCT layer and 52.48% for lesion; RETFound, 94.98% for OCT layer and 62.19% for lesion). Moreover, in MRI-based orbital tumor segmentation, VisionFM achieved a Dice score of 79.49%, significantly exceeding U-Net (Dice score, 41.69%). Ultrasound biomicroscopy landmark detection can facilitate the quantitative measurements of the anterior chamber angle. Therefore, we tested the models’ ability to detect three landmarks in ultrasound biomicroscopy images (dataset details are shown in Supplementary Table S14). VisionFM demonstrated higher accuracy, with an average Euclidean distance error of 4.90 pixels between the predicted and ground truth landmark points, compared with 12.85 pixels for U-Net (Supplementary Table S15). RETFound is not applicable to MRI or ultrasound biomicroscopy modalities. VisionFM also exhibited strong fewshot segmentation capabilities in segmenting OCT layers (Fig. 3B). Its one-shot segmentation capability surpassed U-Net’s ten-shot segmentation (Dice score, 77.54% vs. 76.07%) and significantly exceeded RETFound’s one-shot segmentation (Dice score, 77.54% vs. 59.71%). Figure 3C provides qualitative comparisons of these results, with further details available in the Supplementary Appendix (see Sections 2.5 and 2.6), and Supplementary Figure S7 and Figure S8. In addition, Supplementary Figure S9 highlights the interpretability of VisionFM, providing explainability of ophthalmic imaging representations, a crucial feature for building trust in AI models.

分割及相关能力是衡量医学影像领域基础模型性能的关键指标。图3A总结了VisionFM在一项综合性基准测试中的各类分割任务表现，该基准涵盖22个公开数据集和1个私有数据集（详见补充表S11、表S12和表S13）。在眼底照片的分割任务中，VisionFM对视网膜血管和病灶的Dice相似系数分别达到81.75%和42.07%。值得注意的是，在基于OCT的分割任务中，VisionFM显著优于两种基线模型——RETFound与广泛应用于分割任务的U‑Net（Dice得分：VisionFM分别为OCT各层96.18%、病灶64.65%；U‑Net分别为OCT各层89.70%、病灶52.48%；RETFound分别为OCT各层94.98%、病灶62.19%）。此外，在基于MRI的眼眶肿瘤分割任务中，VisionFM的Dice得分达79.49%，远超U‑Net的41.69%。超声生物显微镜中的关键点检测有助于前房角的定量测量，为此我们评估了各模型在超声生物显微镜图像中检测三个关键点的能力（数据集详情见补充表S14）。结果表明，VisionFM的精度更高，其预测关键点与真实标注之间的平均欧氏距离误差为4.90像素，而U‑Net为12.85像素（详见补充表S15）。其中，RETFound不适用于MRI及超声生物显微镜模态。在OCT各层的分割任务中，VisionFM还展现出优异的小样本分割能力（图3B），其单样本分割性能超越了U‑Net的十样本分割效果（Dice得分分别为77.54% vs. 76.07%），且显著优于RETFound的单样本分割表现（Dice得分分别为77.54% vs. 59.71%）。图3C对上述结果进行了定性对比，更多细节参见补充附录（第2.5节和第2.6节）以及补充图S7和图S8。此外，补充图S9展示了VisionFM的可解释性，揭示了其对眼科影像表征的可说明性，这一特性对于增强用户对AI模型的信任至关重要。

合成眼科影像数据的有效性

EFFECTIVENESS OF SYNTHETIC OPHTHALMIC IMAGING DATA

As a foundation model, VisionFM requires a large volume of pretraining data to develop, but certain imaging modalities that are not commonly performed (e.g., orbital MRI) are dificult to curate. Hence, synthetic data become a potential solution to expand the dataset. Supplementary Figure S10 compares the performance of VisionFM’s slitlamp and MRI encoders that were trained with real data, synthetic data, and various proportions of both, as those two modalities had far less real data compared with the other six. The results revealed that a proper ratio of real to synthetic data improves performance, with the optimal ratio for both slit-lamp and MRI being 1:5 (real:synthetic). It is worth noting that training with only real or only synthetic data achieved similar accuracy, suggesting the potential for synthetic data to substitute real data to encourage data sharing. Supplementary Figure S11 shows examples of synthetic slit-lamp and MRI images used in the study. Supplementary Figure S12 shows the results of visual Turing tests in which ophthalmologists, radiologists, and neurosurgeons were invited to determine whether each image was synthetic or real (Supplementary Table S16). The synthetic slit-lamp data obtained a score of 42.7% ± 12.1%, and MRI data a score of 51.6% ± 4.5%. A score closer to 50% indicates that clinicians were guessing at random. Please refer to the Supplementary Appendix (see Section 1) for details.

作为一种基础模型，VisionFM在训练过程中需要大量预训练数据，但某些临床中并不常见的成像模态（如眼眶MRI）却难以有效采集。因此，合成数据成为扩充数据集的潜在解决方案。补充图S10比较了VisionFM在裂隙灯和MRI编码器上的性能，这些编码器分别采用真实数据、合成数据以及两者按不同比例混合进行训练；由于这两种模态的真实数据远少于其他六种，故作此对比。结果表明，合理的真实数据与合成数据配比能够提升模型性能，其中裂隙灯和MRI的最佳配比均为1:5（真实数据∶合成数据）。值得注意的是，仅使用真实数据或仅使用合成数据所获得的准确率相当，这表明合成数据有望替代真实数据，从而促进数据共享。补充图S11展示了本研究中使用的合成裂隙灯与MRI图像示例。补充图S12则呈现了视觉图灵测试的结果，邀请眼科医师、放射科医师及神经外科医师判断每张图像的真实性与合成性（详见补充表S16）。结果显示，合成裂隙灯图像的识别正确率为42.7%±12.1%，MRI图像为51.6%±4.5%。得分越接近50%，说明临床医生的判断越接近随机猜测。具体细节请参阅补充附录（见第1节）。

讨论

Discussion

As AI becomes a mainstream medical technology, it should be enhanced to solve a wider and more complex range of clinical tasks to address public health and global health challenges. Here, we present VisionFM, a novel, comprehensive ophthalmic image foundation model with generalist intelligence, demonstrating consistent state-of-the-art accuracy across various ophthalmic imaging modalities and clinical tasks.

随着人工智能逐渐成为主流医疗技术，其功能应进一步提升，以应对更为广泛且复杂的临床任务，从而有效应对公共卫生与全球健康领域的挑战。在此，我们提出了VisionFM——一种具备通用智能的新型综合性眼科影像基础模型，在多种眼科成像模态及临床任务上均展现出持续领先的准确性能。

随着人工智能逐渐成为主流医疗技术，其功能应进一步提升，以应对更为广泛且复杂的临床任务，从而有效应对公共卫生与全球健康领域的挑战。在此，我们提出了VisionFM——一种具备通用智能的新型综合性眼科影像基础模型，在多种眼科成像模态及临床任务上均展现出持续领先的准确性能。

VisionFM achieves specialist-level diagnostic accuracy after adaptation, which is particularly valuable due to the variation in global ophthalmic practice and also useful for regions that have limited access to high-quality diagnoses. VisionFM can segment ocular lesions, vessels, and layers, and detects ocular landmarks, ofering interpretable decision support for clinicians.38 With few-shot learning ability, VisionFM could substantially reduce annotation and computing costs. VisionFM shows multifaceted generalization capabilities and robustness to dataset shift. For example, it can generalize to OCTA images for diabetic retinopathy grading despite never being exposed to OCTA during pretraining. To evaluate its generalist intelligence, we introduced and benchmarked a series of new ophthalmic tasks, such as orbital tumor segmentation and intracranial tumor prediction. Additionally, we demonstrated that its performance can be enhanced with the proper proportion of real to synthetic data, supporting collaborative projects that require privacy-preserved data sharing. 39

VisionFM在经过适配后即可达到专科级的诊断准确率，这一特性在全球眼科实践存在差异的背景下尤为宝贵，同时也为医疗资源匮乏、难以获得高质量诊断服务的地区提供了有力支持。VisionFM能够对眼部病灶、血管及各层结构进行分割，并识别眼部关键解剖标志，从而为临床医生提供可解释的决策辅助。凭借其少样本学习能力，VisionFM可显著降低标注与计算成本。此外，VisionFM还展现出多方面的泛化能力以及对数据分布迁移的稳健性；例如，在预训练阶段从未接触过OCTA图像的情况下，仍能将其应用于糖尿病视网膜病变的分级任务。为评估其通用智能水平，我们设计并基准测试了一系列新型眼科任务，如眼眶肿瘤分割与颅内肿瘤预测。同时，我们还证明，通过合理配置真实数据与合成数据的比例，可以进一步提升模型性能，这为需要保护隐私的数据共享合作项目提供了有力支撑。39

While VisionFM’s generalist capabilities were extensively evaluated, its limitations should also be acknowledged. First, although VisionFM’s pretraining data are demographically diverse, it may be biased toward the Chinese population, since the volume of private pretraining data outweighs the public. Hence, VisionFM generally achieves higher accuracy when analyzing Chinese data. Nevertheless, VisionFM demonstrates remarkable accuracy on benchmarks with diverse ethnic groups. A more balanced and inclusive pretraining dataset may improve its accuracy and generalizability.

尽管VisionFM的通用能力已得到全面评估，其局限性亦应予以正视。首先，尽管VisionFM的预训练数据在人口统计学上具有多样性，但由于私有预训练数据的规模远超公开数据，模型仍可能对中国人群体存在一定程度的偏好。因此，在处理中国数据时，VisionFM通常能取得更高的精度。不过，在涵盖多种族群体的基准测试中，VisionFM同样表现出色。构建更加均衡且更具包容性的预训练数据集，有望进一步提升其精度与泛化能力。

Second, VisionFM’s ability to predict intracranial tumors using fundus photographs is promising for community-level screening and ophthalmology department settings. However, the small-scale dataset for this application requires further validation; the definitive diagnosis of an intracranial tumor necessitates a comprehensive evaluation of the patient’s medical history, additional imaging, and other clinical information. Similarly, a larger-scale validation dataset will allow for a more reliable assessment of glaucoma progression forecasting, which could aid early intervention.

其次，VisionFM利用眼底照片预测颅内肿瘤的能力，在社区筛查及眼科临床场景中具有广阔的应用前景。然而，针对该应用场景的小规模数据集尚需进一步验证；颅内肿瘤的最终诊断仍需结合患者的完整病史、其他影像学检查以及相关临床信息进行综合评估。同样地，构建更大规模的验证数据集将有助于更可靠地评估青光眼进展的预测效果，从而为早期干预提供支持。

其次，VisionFM利用眼底照片预测颅内肿瘤的能力，在社区筛查及眼科临床场景中具有广阔的应用前景。然而，针对该应用场景的小规模数据集尚需进一步验证；颅内肿瘤的最终诊断仍需结合患者的完整病史、其他影像学检查以及相关临床信息进行综合评估。同样地，构建更大规模的验证数据集将有助于更可靠地评估青光眼进展的预测效果，从而为早期干预提供支持。

Third, while VisionFM shows promise in predicting systemic biomarkers (e.g., those relevant to gout) from ocular images among individuals who would not routinely have their blood levels checked, its diagnostic accuracy currently falls short of clinical standards for broader translation.

第三，尽管VisionFM在从眼部图像预测系统性生物标志物（例如与痛风相关的指标）方面展现出潜在应用价值——尤其适用于那些平时不会常规检测血清水平的人群——但其诊断准确性目前仍未能达到临床标准，制约了更广泛的实际转化。

第三，尽管VisionFM在从眼部图像预测系统性生物标志物（例如与痛风相关的指标）方面展现出潜在应用价值——尤其适用于那些平时不会常规检测血清水平的人群——但其诊断准确性目前仍未能达到临床标准，制约了更广泛的实际转化。

Fourth, VisionFM’s performance in diagnosing 12 ocular diseases from fundus photographs is comparable to that of intermediate-level ophthalmologists. However, ophthalmologists often use additional clinical information and other imaging modalities to make a diagnosis. Therefore, the diagnostic ability of an ophthalmologist may be underestimated when they are limited to using only fundus photographs.

其四，VisionFM在基于眼底彩照诊断12种眼科疾病方面的性能与中级水平的眼科医师相当。然而，眼科医师在临床实践中通常会结合其他辅助检查信息及多种影像模态进行综合判断，因此，当仅以眼底彩照为依据时，眼科医师的诊断能力可能会被低估。

其四，VisionFM在基于眼底彩照诊断12种眼科疾病方面的性能与中级水平的眼科医师相当。然而，眼科医师在临床实践中通常会结合其他辅助检查信息及多种影像模态进行综合判断，因此，当仅以眼底彩照为依据时，眼科医师的诊断能力可能会被低估。

Fifth, the comparative study presented in this article involved only ophthalmologists from China. Given the potential diferences in medical training and variations in ophthalmic specialties, a larger, more diverse study involving ophthalmologists from multiple countries could provide a more objective comparison between VisionFM and the broader ophthalmological community.

第五，本文开展的比较研究仅纳入了来自中国的眼科医师。鉴于医学教育体系及眼科亚专业的差异性，开展一项规模更大、更具多样性的多国眼科医师参与的研究，将有助于更为客观地比较VisionFM与更广泛的眼科专业群体的表现。

第五，本文开展的比较研究仅纳入了来自中国的眼科医师。鉴于医学教育体系及眼科亚专业的差异性，开展一项规模更大、更具多样性的多国眼科医师参与的研究，将有助于更为客观地比较VisionFM与更广泛的眼科专业群体的表现。

Last, while VisionFM is multimodal and multitask, many more modalities, diseases (especially rare diseases), and clinical tasks have yet to be incorporated and evaluated. However, due to VisionFM’s flexible design, new modalities, diseases, and tasks can be incorporated into the current structure through new encoders and sample-eficient fine-tuning of decoders. Hence, the clinical utility of VisionFM can be extended and verified when more data become available. Moreover, it can be integrated with a large language model40 to generate diagnostic reports.

最后，尽管VisionFM已具备多模态与多任务能力，但仍有许多模态、疾病（尤其是罕见病）以及临床任务有待纳入并加以评估。然而，得益于VisionFM的灵活架构，可通过引入新的编码器，并对解码器进行样本高效的微调，将新模态、新疾病及新任务整合至现有框架中。因此，随着更多数据的积累，VisionFM的临床应用价值有望进一步拓展并得到验证。此外，它还可与大型语言模型相结合，用于生成诊断报告。

最后，尽管VisionFM已具备多模态与多任务能力，但仍有许多模态、疾病（尤其是罕见病）以及临床任务有待纳入并加以评估。然而，得益于VisionFM的灵活架构，可通过引入新的编码器，并对解码器进行样本高效的微调，将新模态、新疾病及新任务整合至现有框架中。因此，随着更多数据的积累，VisionFM的临床应用价值有望进一步拓展并得到验证。此外，它还可与大型语言模型相结合，用于生成诊断报告。

In summary, as a multimodal multitask generalist foundation model, VisionFM efectively covers eight ophthalmic clinical imaging modalities and a multitude of clinical tasks. Its functionality can be extended by incorporating new imaging modalities and tasks through self-supervised pretraining and supervised fine-tuning, enabling it to manage an even broader range of ophthalmic diseases and clinical challenges.

总之，作为一种多模态、多任务的通用基础模型，VisionFM能够有效覆盖八种眼科临床影像模态及多种临床任务。通过自监督预训练与有监督微调，其功能可进一步扩展至新的影像模态与任务，从而应对更为广泛的眼科疾病与临床难题。

总之，作为一种多模态、多任务的通用基础模型，VisionFM能够有效覆盖八种眼科临床影像模态及多种临床任务。通过自监督预训练与有监督微调，其功能可进一步扩展至新的影像模态与任务，从而应对更为广泛的眼科疾病与临床难题。
